youtube_title: I asked for one sign to put the tree up tonight. The box in the garage answered 🎄
description:
Marcy wants the tree up on Thanksgiving night. Glen says the rule is December first. The tree box in the garage keeps sending signs, and it has a secret about where the tree went.

#cartoon #animation #funny #christmastree #shorts
tiktok_caption: this is your sign to put the tree up tonight 🎄 #cartoon #animation #funny #christmastree

lines.text: I need one sign. Just one. And the tree goes up tonight.
This is your sign.
Marcy, the box in the garage is talking again.
I am the tree box. I have been in this garage since January. I have a lot of feelings.
The rule is December first. We do not put up the tree on Thanksgiving night.
The rule is from your dad. Your dad also irons his socks.
And his socks look amazing. No tree.
Fine. You want signs? I will give you signs.
The radio just played sleigh bells. For forty minutes. On the weather station.
That is a coincidence. Weather can be festive.
The weather man said, light snow, and also this is your sign, Marcy.
He did not say that.
He said it twice. Once very slowly.
Sign number two. I cut the pumpkin pie and the crack is shaped like a star.
That is a pie that needed more time in the oven.
That is a pie with a message.
Pies do not send messages, box.
Boxes do not talk, Glen. And yet, here we are.
Sign number three. The neighbors put up their lights tonight. They spell my name.
They spell Mary. They are missing a letter.
The C fell off. It is in the bushes. It is also a sign.
Everything is a sign to you two. The doorbell. The toaster.
The toaster said ding. Ding is a holiday word.
That is enough. I am opening the box.
Wait. Marcy. Do not open the box.
Why not?
Go ahead. Open me. I have been waiting to say this for five weeks.
It is empty. There is no tree in here.
I have been empty since October. He took the tree.
Glen. Where is the tree?
What tree? I am a December first man.
Check the guest room.
Glen. The tree is in the guest room. It is fully decorated. It has a little chair next to it.
And your slippers. And a mug. And a blanket with snowmen on it.
Okay. Fine. I put it up on October third.
Every year it comes down too fast. I just wanted more time with it.
So I sit with it. After dinner. Every night. We talk.
It does not talk. I talk. The tree just listens.
You made me do the December rule for nine years.
I did the December rule out loud. On the inside I am a September man.
That is the most romantic weird thing you have ever done.
I am going to need you two to carry it downstairs. I miss it.
So this is your sign. The tree comes down. To the living room.
Wait. One more question.
This is your sign to tell me what else is in the guest room closet.
The November tree.
I knew it. I am not the only box in this house.
